Congress criticizes Great Nicobar Project, citing environmental disaster concerns

The Congress party has raised concerns regarding the Great Nicobar Project, with leader Jairam Ramesh stating that Prime Minister Modi is leading the nation towards an "environmental disaster." The party is questioning the project's potential impact and urging reconsideration. This criticism highlights a debate over development versus ecological preservation in the region.
